hotspots.label: Single Loop
hotspots.description: The one and only path every component rides together.
hotspots.colorHint: A single cool-grey loop curving through all bulbs.

hotspots.label: Bulb A
hotspots.description: First link of the chain, carrying the same current as the rest.
hotspots.colorHint: Warm bulb on the loop's left.
hotspots.function: Demo bulb A of the series chain.

hotspots.label: Bulb B
hotspots.description: Middle link; removing it opens the entire loop.
hotspots.colorHint: Warm bulb at the apex of the chain.
hotspots.function: The test bulb one can pop.

hotspots.label: Bulb C
hotspots.description: Last link, equally dim as the others, sharing their fate.
hotspots.colorHint: Warm bulb on the loop's right.

hotspots.label: Battery
hotspots.description: The source whose total volts split across the three bulbs.
hotspots.colorHint: Small blue battery at the loop's tail.

hotspots.label: Ammeter
hotspots.description: The gauge that reads the same amps wherever you probe the loop.
hotspots.function: Proves the identical current at every point.

hotspots.label: Remove / Replace Bulb B
hotspots.description: The 'pop a bulb' test that takes the whole series dark.
hotspots.colorHint: A small unscrew chip above the middle bulb.

visualStyleNotes: Warm off-white paper ground, soft vignette. A single loop of cool wire carrying three warm bulbs in a chain, one battery, a green ammeter.
materialNotes: Metallic=0 for bulbs (warm rough glass) and loop wire grey-slick roughness 0.3; no bloom.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: series circuit behavior on one shared loop.

GEOMETRY: rectangular ribbon loop with bulbs at (-0.7,0.3,0.1),(0,0.9,0.1),(0.7,0.3,0.1); battery at loop tail; ammeter stand; a probe marker; an unscrew chip at the apex.

INTERACTION: clicking any bulb flashes its ammeter value (all identical); the chip removes bulb B; removing it freezes and dims the others; putting it back restores all.

NAMED NODES: SeriesLoop, BulbA, BulbB, BulbC, Cell, Ammeter, RemoveChip. 8-11k tris.
